headlines.title: America defeated measles in 2000. Vaccine opposition brought it roaring back.
headlines.description: An NBC News investigation finds three-quarters of counties with recent data on kindergarten immunization rates are below the threshold for community measles protection.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Inside the Benefits (and Downsides) of Napping
headlines.description: Taking a short midday snooze can be a good way to recharge and give your brain a boost so Dr. Saema Tahir, a sleep and pulmonary specialist, joins TODAY with everything you need to know, including the biggest mistakes people make when napping.

headlines.title: FDA Orders Warning Label on GLP-1s for Risk of Eye Condition
headlines.description: The FDA is now mandating GLP-1 weight loss drugs carry a warning label that the medications carry “a potential increased risk” of a rare eye condition that may cause permanent vision loss.

headlines.title: Multiple California half-marathon runners hospitalized with ‘unusual symptoms’
headlines.description: An investigation is underway after at least 25 runners sought medical treatment for “unusual symptoms" after running a half marathon in Santa Barbara, California. Santa Barbara News-Press reporter Angel Corzo spoke with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about the police investigation.

headlines.title: FDA orders warning on popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs
headlines.description: There’s a new alert on those popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs. The FDA is now mandating a warning label that the drugs may cause sudden blindness. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: 8 Thanksgiving meal kits that’ll take cooking off your to-do list — starting at just $25
headlines.description: I found the best Thanksgiving meal kits to order ahead of time from Walmart, Whole Foods, Costco and more, starting at just $25 with promo codes and deals.

headlines.title: The best turkey roasting pans for every budget and bird size
headlines.description: Get your Thanksgiving turkey golden and juicy with the best roasting pans of 2026, from stainless steel and nonstick picks to budget-friendly disposable options.

headlines.title: 19+ cozy gifts that could turn anyone into a homebody this holiday season
headlines.description: Snuggle up indoors this winter with robes, candles, skin care and more from Lego, Necessaire, Buffy and other brands that make your comfort and coziness a priority.

headlines.title: Lola vs. Comfrt vs. Cocoon: Which brand has the best plush blanket?
headlines.description: I tested three of the best, ultra-soft plush blankets from Lola Blankets, Comfrt and Cocoon, to see which is the best all around.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.
